hook: Brendan Foody is a co-founder and chief executive of Mercor, the San Francisco company that pays doctors, lawyers, bankers and engineers to train and test AI models for the major labs. Before Mercor he ran a cloud consulting business that saved corporate clients money on AWS and a short-lived compute startup, Seros, then left Georgetown in 2023 to build Mercor full time.
name: Brendan Foody

secondary.name: TechCrunch on Mercor's founders and its 2025 funding (2025)
TechCrunch, Mercor is in talks for a $20B valuation (July 2026)

timeline.event: Founds a cloud consulting business built on AWS promotions
timeline.impact: Works with hundreds of corporate clients while still in school

timeline.event: Founds Seros, aimed at globalizing access to compute
timeline.impact: Wound down at the end of 2022

timeline.event: Co-founds Mercor with Adarsh Hiremath and Surya Midha and leaves Georgetown
timeline.impact: An AI hiring platform that becomes a marketplace of experts who train AI models
Two year fellowship for founders who leave school

timeline.event: Mercor raises a $350 million Series C at a $10 billion valuation, led by Felicis
timeline.impact: One of the fastest risers among AI data companies

timeline.event: Shares the chief executive role with Adarsh Hiremath; Mercor reports a run rate above $2 billion and buys Deeptune
timeline.impact: A year that also brought a data breach and lawsuits from contract workers

quick_facts: Co-founder and chief executive officer of Mercor since January 2023, sharing the chief executive role with Adarsh Hiremath since January 2026
Studied business administration and economics at Georgetown University (2021 to 2023); Thiel Fellow since March 2024
Earlier founded a cloud consulting business (2020 to 2022) and Seros (2022), a startup aimed at globalizing access to compute
Won the Georgetown Entrepreneurship Challenge, the Ventures and Values Pitch Competition and the BIG EAST Startup Challenge; speaks Spanish
